guide.overview: A lethal **physical AoE DPS**, Red Hood Knightfight is built around **crit-triggered AoE grenades**. [Bat Family] and [League of Assassins] allies raise his Crit Rate even further.

legacyPieces.name: Knightbow
legacyPieces.reason: When Red Hood Knightfight lands a critical hit, his basic attack switches to rapid fire, dealing physical damage based on his Attack and the target's Max HP to two enemies.

legacyPieces.name: T-Sphere Weakness Analyzer
legacyPieces.reason: Increases Crit Rate and Crit Damage, helping Red Hood Knightfight trigger his AoE basic attacks more reliably and maintain a steady burst cycle.

legacyPieces.name: Cold Gun
legacyPieces.reason: Boosts Attack and Accuracy, ensuring Red Hood Knightfight lands both his arrows and AoE basic attacks consistently.

legacyPieces.name: Lawton Rifle Scope
legacyPieces.reason: Provides reliable Attack and Crit Rate bonuses, giving Red Hood Knightfight steady damage output even before his faction Crit Rate bonus is fully stacked.
